segments.name: MedSurg
segments.description: Develops and manufactures minimally invasive devices for endoscopic, urological and neuromodulation treatments for physicians and patients.
segments.evidence: Our core businesses are organized into two reportable segments: MedSurg and Cardiovascular.

segments.name: Cardiovascular
segments.description: Develops and manufactures devices and technologies for diagnosing and treating heart, peripheral arterial, venous diseases and various cancers.
segments.evidence: Our Cardiovascular business develops and manufactures devices and medical technologies for diagnosing and treating a variety of diseases and abnormalities of the heart, as well as products to diagnose and treat peripheral arterial and venous diseases and various forms of cancer.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net sales from selling medical devices to customers such as hospitals and physicians who use them to diagnose and treat patients.
revenueModel.evidence: Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions.

changes.text: In 2025, the legacy Cardiology and Peripheral Interventions businesses were combined into a single Cardiovascular business, with no impact on reportable segments.
changes.evidence: In the fourth quarter of 2025, an organizational change combined our legacy Cardiology and Peripheral Interventions businesses into a single Cardiovascular business.
